summary: Iter 15 — ARIA brand redesign verified end-to-end. Backend 9/9 smoke endpoints (health, auth, leads, billing/plans, billing/current-plan, aria/call-priority, lead-magnets/recent-opens, ttv/milestones) return 200 with expected shapes. Frontend: all 9 routes (Dashboard, Lead Inbox, Pipeline, Follow-Ups, AI Assistant, Reports, Integrations, Plan & Billing, Settings) load without errors. New ARIA Command Center header (eyebrow + h1 + subtitle), AriaInsightCard with [data-testid=aria-insight-card] (dynamic 'sleeping leads' variant rendered), dark gradient sidebar 'linear-gradient(rgb(14,8,32),rgb(26,15,56))', brand block 'ARIA / AI SALES PA · GENLEADAI', active nav purple left border (3px solid #C044E0) + white text, plan-badge in white, topbar-add-lead + topbar-ai-summary present. PageHeaders render correctly on FollowUps ('Follow-Up Command Center'), AIAssistant ('ARIA AI Assistant' + 'ARIA · AI SALES PA' eyebrow), Integrations ('Connect ARIA With Your Growth Stack' + 'GROWTH STACK' eyebrow), Billing ('Choose your sales operating layer' + 'ARIA PLANS' + 'Compare every feature' matrix). Plan-badge click opens UpgradeModal correctly. Iter14 sidebar testid bug ('nav-plan-&-billing') is FIXED — now correctly renders 'nav-plan-billing'.
action_items: [Pre-existing, not introduced this iter] react-beautiful-dnd dev warning 'Invariant failed: isDropDisabled must be a boolean' fires ~21 times on Pipeline/DnD-using pages. Library is in dev-only-warning mode. Optional: pass explicit isDropDisabled={false} in <Droppable> props to silence. Non-blocking, dev-only.

[Optional / Phase 2] Iter14 nested <button> hydration warning on /billing plan cards was previously reported — please verify Billing.js plan-card-pro doesn't still nest buttons (not re-verified this run since pages now use PageHeader and component changes may have refactored).
critical_code_review_comments: Layout.js:47 — testid generation now uses /[^a-z0-9]+/g + trim. Verified 'nav-plan-billing' testid is correct. Iter14 bug fixed.
Layout.js — Dark sidebar uses var(--sidebar-bg) tokens correctly with linear-gradient. Active state uses border-left + background combo via NavLink style fn. Clean.
AriaInsightCard.js — accepts tone='default'|'urgent', renders gradient + 'ARIA says' eyebrow. Optional CTA is button (not anchor) — fine since it uses navigate(). Good a11y baseline.
PageHeader.js — small focused component (28 lines), accepts eyebrow/title/subtitle/actions/children. Reused on FollowUps, AIAssistant, Integrations, Billing. Good DRY.
Dashboard.js still has its own bespoke header (not PageHeader) — by design (Command Center variant). Works but consider whether to unify in Phase 2.
react-beautiful-dnd is unmaintained (last release 2022). Consider migrating to @hello-pangea/dnd (drop-in replacement) to eliminate the recurring dev warning and gain React 18+ support.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (9/9 routes load, all required testids + headers + brand elements present)
